A '''racing droid''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that could be used for racing. At some point, a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] ship in the employ of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Darga Jiramma Mionne]] obtained some advanced droid interface technology from the edges of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and Darga ordered his technicians to use to technology to create toys, for his personal amusement. The results of their endeavors were a set of racing droids, which could be remotely controlled via a visor that allowed the user to see out of the droids' eyes. Darga encouraged members of his court to race the droids on a track inside [[Darga the Hutt's palace|his palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] and he gave lavish rewards to the winners of the races.
